name: FedReTrust

scope.participation: fixed known clients, all participate, contiguous rounds starting at 1
scope.model: one global model; submitted delta = trained model minus broadcast
scope.sample_weights: p_i = saved server-known client sample count / total saved count
scope.reference: same reserved 300 clean training images as FLTrust
scope.reference_protocol_note: The old calibration pilot says FLTrust only because FedReTrust was not implemented; Step 6/7 must explicitly extend the shared reference-access declaration without changing that historical pilot.

parameter_provenance: All policy constants are proposed illustrative choices, not estimates, published defaults or final tuned settings. Numerical epsilons are engineering conventions. Step 7 must predeclare a small joint candidate set and include all variants in the compute budget.

geometry.radius: C = clip_multiplier * arithmetic median of ALL current raw delta norms, including zeros
geometry.clipped_delta: If C or raw norm <= norm_epsilon: b=0,k=0; otherwise k=min(1,C/norm), b=k*delta
geometry.loss_probe: h_i = [CE_R(w + eta*p_i*b_i) - CE_R(w)] / max(CE_R(w),loss_epsilon); use independent eval-mode copies
geometry.root_cosine: cos(b_i, current root delta), undefined if either norm <= epsilon
geometry.peer_cosine: arithmetic median cosine with other nonzero clipped deltas; undefined if none
geometry.history_cosine: cos(b_i, previous direction memory), undefined if either norm <= epsilon
geometry.unusual: any defined root/peer/history cosine < 0 OR clipping k < 1
geometry.discordant: defined root cosine < 0 OR defined peer cosine < 0
geometry.history_update: after decisions, u <- lambda*u + (1-lambda)*unit(b), with unit(0)=0; EMA is decaying, not a hard finite window

evidence_priority.condition: h < -relative_loss_tolerance OR (h <= relative_loss_tolerance AND NOT unusual AND current_geometry_available)

state.episode: A maximal consecutive B/X run is confirmed at its Kth observation or first X. Record that confirmation round once. Prune onsets outside [t-H+1,t]. G/U/N end the run; continued B/X never append extra onsets.
state.good_streak: increment on G up to K+H; reset on every other category
state.restoration_requirement: K + number of recorded episode onsets currently in window
state.restoration_rate: restoration_increment / (1 + number of recorded episode onsets currently in window)

provisional_multiplier.G: If trust=1: Stable,q*=1. Else hold trust and Penalised while good streak < K+m; otherwise raise trust by restoration_increment/(1+m), capped at 1, and use Recovering or Stable. q*=new trust.
provisional_multiplier.N: retain trust and label; q*=0; no passive restoration

state.allowance: For B/U/X, q=min(q*,remaining_allowance), then deduct q. G resets allowance to non_supportive_allowance and uses q=q*. N uses q=0 and leaves allowance unchanged. The allowance bounds sum(q) over every interval with no G; it is not an intent score.
state.state_label_note: Retained trust, provisional multiplier and applied multiplier are distinct. Uncertain may have zero applied influence after allowance exhaustion; Penalised can retain an intermediate trust value while renewed evidence accumulates. Labels are decisions, not true client types.

aggregation.normalization: fixed original sample denominator; no division by Z
aggregation.all_zero: keep broadcast; continue observation and state updates
aggregation.numerics: float64 norms, cosine, counters' scalar arithmetic and accumulation; clamp cosine to [-1,1]; cast aggregate once to model dtype; reject nonfinite arithmetic before committing any state

success_margin_status: planning proposals only; supervisor discussion and Step 7 preregistration required before final outcomes
carry_forward: SR-07 threshold sensitivity and fixed-partition limits
next_action: supervisor discussion; Step 6 implementation with GPT-6.1 Sol Extra High after incorporating feedback
targeted_control_dependency_rule: Add clean to every variant; add mixed_drift_only_control for mixed_drift_and_attack. Deduplicate per variant.
